photos.title: Boat Day in Phi Phi

photos.title: Scouting The Karst Islands

photos.title: Harbor View, Limestone Cliffs

photos.title: Head Pat at Elephant Sanctuary
photos.caption: She leaned in for scratches and I was not about to leave her hanging.

photos.title: Misty Mountains, Big Friend

photos.title: Elephant Side-Eye Check

photos.title: Rain Poncho, Big Neighbor

photos.title: Peace Sign, Baby Elephant

photos.title: Mom And Calf Jungle Moment
photos.caption: Caught a mom and calf snacking in the jungle—turns out family dinner looks the same at every scale.

photos.title: Purple Shades, Elephant Lunch
photos.caption: Wore ridiculous purple shades to an elephant sanctuary because confidence is half the fit check.

photos.title: Devcon Seven SEA Sign

photos.title: Purple Beanbag Conference Lounge

photos.title: Hotel Mirror Fit Check

photos.title: Festival Pad Thai Bowl

photos.title: Golden Hour Fried Chicken

photos.title: Kad Mua Meatball Skewer

photos.title: Monks Candlelight Ceremony Night

photos.title: Night Temple Buddha Glow

photos.title: Colombian Gallery Corner
photos.caption: Three paintings in one corner and still no consensus on what my apartment actually needs.

photos.title: La Candelaria Art Market

photos.title: Rooftop Coffee Over Andes

photos.title: Muisca Raft Gold Museum

photos.title: Comuna 13 Outdoor Slides

photos.title: Comuna Trece Slide

photos.title: Thailand Lantern Lighting
